ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central regions (~70%) with high-contrast low-intensity (black) pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edges, tips, and vertical streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; dense, irregular black vertical and diagonal streaks (mottling) radiating from the trailing edge toward the peduncle on both lobes; solid black focal region at the central notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep, narrow vertex and sharp interior pixel transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with numerous high-amplitude serrations, including deep notches at the 1/3 and 2/3 positions on the right lobe and significant jagged variations along the left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature of the outer trailing edges transitioning into a sharp, upward-sloping lateral tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast beige/white pixel nodules (barnacle colonization) localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (dark rake marks on white background and white scratches on black margins) across the central surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lobe tips and multiple irregular healed notches/amputations along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark, annular (ring-shaped) mark located on the mid-right lobe approximately halfway between the notch and the trailing edge.
